proposals.before: South of Liangxiang his own officers turned on him. Fearing capture, Zhu Fu dismounted and killed his wife to flee alone. The city fell to Peng Chong. Minister Secretary Hou Ba accused him of ruining Youzhou, inventing charges against Peng Chong, wasting the army, and failing to die with honor—all capital offenses.
proposals.after: Southward, on reaching Liangxiang, his troop chief turned and blocked him. Fearing he could not escape, Zhu Fu dismounted and stabbed his wife to death, barely escaping with his life alone. The city fell to Peng Chong. Minister Secretary Hou Ba accused him of ruining Youzhou, inventing charges against Peng Chong, wasting the army, and failing to die with honor—all capital offenses.
proposals.reason: Chinese 南至良鄉 means arriving southward at Liangxiang, not 'south of' it; 兵長 is a singular troop chief, not plural officers.

proposals.before: At that time the two commanderies were rebellious and depraved; the northern province was anxious and fearful; Fu thought the Son of Heaven would surely himself lead troops to punish them, but only sent Mobile General Deng Long secretly to aid Fu.
proposals.after: At that time the two commanderies were rebellious and depraved; the northern province was anxious and fearful; Fu thought the Son of Heaven would surely himself lead troops to punish them, but he only sent Mobile General Deng Long secretly to aid Fu.
proposals.reason: The English drops the imperial subject of 而但遣, making 'sent' wrongly attach to Fu; the sender is the Son of Heaven.

proposals.before: You and Geng Yan both rose to help found the dynasty and share its favor.
proposals.after: You and Geng Kuang both rose to help found the dynasty and share its favor.
proposals.reason: 耿俠遊 identifies Geng Kuang by his courtesy name Xiayou; it does not refer to his son Geng Yan.

proposals.before: Geng Yan is humble and often speaks of his own unworthiness;
proposals.after: Geng Kuang is humble and often speaks of his own unworthiness;
proposals.reason: 俠遊 is Geng Kuang's courtesy name, so the English personal name must be Geng Kuang rather than Geng Yan.

proposals.before: In the Yongping period someone with solitary words denounced Fu's affairs; Emperor Xiaozong was greatly angered and granted Fu death.
proposals.after: In the Yongping period someone with solitary words denounced Fu's affairs; Emperor Xianzong was greatly angered and granted Fu death.
proposals.reason: 顯宗 is the temple name Xianzong, not Xiaozong; the literal English misreads the temple-name transcription.

proposals.before: His ancestors were a collateral branch of Wei; they ate vegetables at Feng city and thereby took it as surname.
proposals.after: His ancestors were a collateral branch of Wei; they held the fief-revenues of Feng city and thereby took it as surname.
proposals.reason: 食菜 is a corruption of classical 食采 (to enjoy the revenues of a fief); ate vegetables invents a false meaning the idiomatic correctly avoids.

proposals.before: He married Emperor Xiaozong's daughter the senior princess of Huojia; in youth was attendant at the palace gates; by respectful solemnity and humble restraint was acclaimed; rank reached superintendent of works.
proposals.after: He married Emperor Xianzong's daughter the senior princess of Huojia; in youth was attendant at the palace gates; by respectful solemnity and humble restraint was acclaimed; rank reached superintendent of works.
proposals.reason: 顯宗 is temple name Xianzong (Emperor Ming), not Xiaozong; the literal English misidentifies the emperor.

proposals.before: In the sixth year Emperor Xiaozong visited Lu and again acted as Commandant of the Guards.
proposals.after: In the sixth year Emperor Xianzong visited Lu, and Fang again acted as Commandant of the Guards.
proposals.reason: 顯宗 is Xianzong, not Xiaozong; and 復行衛尉事 continues Feng Fang as silent subject, not the emperor.

proposals.before: At the beginning of Yongping there was Xinye merit assessor Deng Yan; as a minor marquis by imperial marriage he often attended court assembly; his bearing and gait stood out from the crowd; Emperor Xiaozong eyed him and said to those beside him: 'Does my deportment match such a man!'
proposals.after: At the beginning of Yongping there was Xinye merit assessor Deng Yan; as a minor marquis by imperial marriage he often attended court assembly; his bearing and gait stood out from the crowd; Emperor Xianzong eyed him and said to those beside him: 'Does my deportment match such a man!'
proposals.reason: 顯宗 is temple name Xianzong (Emperor Ming), not Xiaozong; the literal English misreads the temple name.

proposals.before: Yu Fang, a collateral descendant of Yu Yan, styled Zizhong.
proposals.after: Yu Fang, a collateral great-grandson of Yu Yan, styled Zizhong.
proposals.reason: 從曾孫 specifically means collateral great-grandson, not a generic collateral descendant.

proposals.before: Zheng Hong, styled Junju, came from Shanyin in Kuaiji commandery.
proposals.after: Zheng Hong, styled Jujun, came from Shanyin in Kuaiji commandery.
proposals.reason: 巨君 is Jujun; Junju reverses the syllable order of the courtesy name.

proposals.before: Emperor Xiaozong awakened and understood; immediately pardoned his family members; Hong personally escorted Kuang's corpse and wife and children returning to village; from this name became manifest.
proposals.after: Emperor Xianzong awakened and understood; immediately pardoned his family members; Hong personally escorted Kuang's corpse and wife and children returning to village; from this name became manifest.
proposals.reason: 顯宗 is temple name Xianzong (Emperor Ming), not Xiaozong; the literal field mistranslates the temple name.

proposals.before: In Yanping 1 he became Minister of the Imperial Clan.
proposals.after: In Yanping 1 he became Minister of the Imperial Household.
proposals.reason: 光祿勳 is the Minister/Chamberlain of the Imperial Household (guanglu xun), not the Minister of the Imperial Clan (宗正).

proposals.before: In the first year of Yanping he became Minister of the Imperial Clan.
proposals.after: In the first year of Yanping he became Minister of the Imperial Household.
proposals.reason: 光祿勳 is mistranslated as Imperial Clan; it denotes the Imperial Household office.

decisions.reason: 南至良鄉 means arriving southward at Liangxiang, and 兵長 is singular; the original's 'south of' and plural 'officers' misread both, while the proposed text also restores 恐不得脫 and 刺殺…僅以身免.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 南至良鄉，其兵長反遮之，浮恐不得脫，乃下馬刺殺其妻，僅以身免

decisions.after: At that time the two commanderies were rebellious and depraved; the northern province was anxious and fearful; Fu thought the Son of Heaven would surely himself lead troops to punish them, but the Son of Heaven only sent Mobile General Deng Long secretly to aid Fu.
decisions.reason: 而但遣 continues the imperial agent of 天子必自將兵討之, not Fu; the proposal's bare 'he' remains ambiguous after Fu as main-clause subject, so the Son of Heaven is named explicitly.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 浮以為天子必自將兵討之，而但遣遊擊將軍鄧隆陰助浮

decisions.reason: 耿俠遊 is Geng Kuang under his courtesy name Xiayou, not his son Geng Yan; the original misidentifies the person.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 伯通與耿俠遊俱起佐命

decisions.reason: 俠遊 is the same courtesy name for Geng Kuang as in s0022; rendering it as Geng Yan is a naming error.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 俠遊廉讓，屢有降挹之言

decisions.reason: 顯宗 romanizes as Xianzong; Xiaozong would require 孝宗, which the Chinese does not have.
食菜馮城 is the classical fief-revenue idiom (食采), not literal vegetable-eating; the proposed literal matches the idiomatic sense already present.
顯宗 is temple name Xianzong; Xiaozong is a false romanization of the same characters.
顯宗 is Xianzong, and 復行衛尉事 resumes Feng Fang as silent subject after 顯宗幸魯; the original wrongly makes the emperor the office-holder.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 六年，顯宗幸魯，復行衛尉事。

decisions.reason: 顯宗 romanizes as Xianzong, not Xiaozong.
從曾孫 is specifically collateral great-grandson; 'collateral descendant' drops the generational precision the Chinese states.
巨君 is Jujun; Junju reverses the courtesy-name syllables.
顯宗 is Xianzong; Xiaozong misreads the temple name.
光祿勳 is the Imperial Household office, not 宗正 (Minister of the Imperial Clan).
Same unit: 光祿勳 denotes Minister of the Imperial Household, not Imperial Clan.
